invariants.statement: GitHub is the sole write and merge authority; any mirrors are review-only projections.
main deploys/releases and dev contains main; neither is ever force-pushed.
Promotions and releases use merge commits; only the sync workflow reconciles dev.
Current truth, approved target, and historical evidence are distinct.
Every governed instruction/document has one disposition and owner phase.
No phase starts, completes, or advances without evidence and explicit user confirmation.
Keystores, signing passwords, and API secrets never appear in Git URLs, files, or logs.
Privileged workflows never execute or inspect untrusted PR content.
All dependencies, plugins, and toolchains are pinned in libs.versions.toml; no dynamic + versions.
Gradle wrapper uses distribution SHA-256 checksum verification.
domain and model layers are pure Kotlin; they must never import android.* or androidx.*.
UI state in Jetpack Compose is unidirectional (UDF); ViewModels expose immutable StateFlow.
Unit tests for domain and ViewModels run on JVM without requiring Android emulators.
UI tests prioritize fast JVM screenshot tests; emulator runs are serialized and isolated.
